walletPolicy.boundsSubtitle: Applied to every student on every top-up channel.
walletPolicy.minHint: Keeps dust amounts off the payment gateway. Currently:

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.subtitle: Every back-office action, in order, with before and after state.
auditLog.appendOnlyBody: The database revokes UPDATE and DELETE on this table for the application role, so an entry cannot be edited or removed from any app surface — including by a super admin.
auditLog.emptyBody: Widen the search or clear the filters above.
auditLog.loadError: Could not load the audit log

oversight.appendOnlyBody: Every ledger on this page is history and cannot be edited or deleted — the database revokes UPDATE and DELETE on the transaction and points ledgers for the application role, super admins included. The actions below ADD to it through the real flows (recorded payment, wallet top-up, walk-in subscription, payout request); nothing anywhere rewrites a past row or sets a balance directly.
oversight.noLedgerRows: No ledger rows for this center.
oversight.refundFlagNote: “Mark refunded” on a payment is a STATUS FLAG — it writes no ledger reversal and returns no money. Use the finance refund flow to actually return money; it is limited to one refund per payment.
oversight.walletScopeNote: Student wallet movements credited at this center (cash top-ups taken at its counter). Spending elsewhere belongs to that other center's books.
oversight.reasonPlaceholder: Recorded in the audit log alongside who, what and when.
oversight.reasonRequiredToast: A reason is required for this action
oversight.actionDone: Done — the action was recorded in the audit log
oversight.headerDesc: Full read visibility across this center, plus a fixed set of audited control actions. Financial records are visible but never editable here.
oversight.deactivateBody: Its center-admin accounts are suspended with it, and every live session is cut on the next request. Courses, enrollments, rosters and all financial history are left untouched — reactivating restores access exactly.
oversight.activateBody: Its center-admin accounts are reactivated with it and can sign in again.
oversight.editableBody: Identity and contact details only. The wallet balance, receipt sequence, short ID and account status are not editable from this form — and neither are the revenue split or commission percentages, which keep their own pricing screen so a money-sensitive number never has two edit paths.
oversight.profileSaved: Profile updated — recorded in the audit log
oversight.auditTitle: Every control action on this center
oversight.auditBody: Who did it, what changed (before and after), and when. The audit table itself is append-only at the database level — it cannot be edited or erased from here.
oversight.approveQ: Approve on behalf of the platform?
oversight.rejectQ: Reject on behalf of the platform?
oversight.approveBody: Creates the affiliation, the course, its sessions and the frozen pricing snapshot in one transaction. Both the teacher and the center are notified that the platform decided.
oversight.approveMethodNote: This hall offers both pricing methods and the teacher never chose one. Approving here applies whole-room %.
oversight.rejectBody: The request is closed and both sides are notified with the reason. No course or schedule is created.
oversight.pf_noCenterCanBody: They exist for platform support, so each one is narrow and says what it will not do. Moving a course between centers is deliberately not offered — its pricing was frozen from this center and its sessions have settled here.
oversight.pf_moveStudent: Move a student to another center
oversight.pf_rosterOnlyBody: Enrollments, subscriptions, payments and wallet history stay at this center.
oversight.pf_moveNeeds: Student, destination and a reason are required
oversight.pf_onRoster: The student is now on the destination center's roster.
oversight.pf_logoutBody: Kills every live session on the account's next request. It changes no status and deletes nothing — the person can sign straight back in. If you mean to stop them using the platform, deactivate the account instead.
oversight.pf_logoutOk: Every live session for that account is now dead
oversight.pf_logoutNeeds: A user id and a reason are required
oversight.pf_dobBody2: unless a verified date of birth shows 18 or over, and parent oversight of their conversations is active for every minor.
oversight.pf_yearsOldAdult: years old — verifying this makes them an adult, and their parent will no longer be able to see their conversations with staff and teachers.
oversight.pf_yearsOldMinor: years old — still a minor, so parent oversight stays on.
oversight.pf_dobOk: Date of birth verified — recorded in the audit log
oversight.pf_dobNeeds: Student, date of birth and a reason are required
oversight.ma_realFlows: These are the real flows, not ledger edits
oversight.ma_realFlowsBody: Each one writes through the money engine with a receipt or reference number, exactly as the center's own counter does. None of them edits a ledger row or sets a balance — those stay impossible, for a super admin too.
oversight.ma_creditOnlyBody: There is no counter-side withdrawal anywhere in the product — money goes in here, and only the student's own spending or a refund takes it out.
oversight.ma_walkInNote: The charge is the course's configured plan price — there is no amount field, so no number can be entered here.
oversight.ma_amountFull: Amount (EGP — blank means the full balance)
oversight.ma_needAmountDate: A positive amount and a date are required
oversight.ma_needStudentCourse: Pick a student and a course
oversight.ma_needStudentAmount: Pick a student and enter a positive amount
oversight.ma_paymentOk: Payment recorded — receipt issued and mirrored to the ledger
oversight.ma_topUpOk: Wallet topped up — receipt issued and mirrored to the ledger
oversight.ma_payoutOk: Payout requested — pending the accountant's approval
oversight.op_settledLockedBody: Once a session has been settled its revenue is already distributed, so it can no longer be cancelled, moved, or completed again. Completing a session is the one action on this screen that writes to the ledger — it always shows a preview first.
oversight.op_writesToLedgerBody: It runs the same settlement the teacher's own “complete” runs, at the rates frozen onto this course when it was created. It happens exactly once — a settled session cannot be settled again.
oversight.op_correctNoMoney: Correcting a settled session does not move money
oversight.op_correctNoMoneyBody: The attendance record is the truth about a student, so it can always be corrected. But if the session has already settled, the settlement is NOT recomputed — that would re-rate a distributed lesson. The divergence from the settled headcount is written into the audit log instead of being discovered later.
oversight.op_softDeleteBody: The account is marked deleted and its live session is cut on the next request, but the row survives — so payments, settlements and every ledger reference to that person stay resolvable. Nothing financial is erased.
oversight.op_financialPreserved3: — nothing in the ledger is removed or rewritten.
oversight.op_accountSoftDeleted: The account is soft-deleted and loses access on its very next request.
oversight.op_accountKeepsWorking: The account keeps working. Your note is recorded.
oversight.op_nobodyBlocked: Nobody is blocked at this center.
oversight.op_attendanceCorrected: Attendance corrected — recorded in the audit log
oversight.op_needDateTimesReason: Date, times and a reason are required
oversight.op_sessionCompleted: Session completed — revenue distributed and recorded in the audit log
oversight.op_sessionPostponed: Session postponed — students notified, recorded in the audit log
oversight.op_needBroadcast: Title, message and (for a course broadcast) a course are required
oversight.pp_staffNoPassword: Staff never receive a password from anyone
oversight.pp_staffNoPasswordBody: A new staff account is created as a shell and emailed a single-use claim link — the person sets their own credential. Re-sending is refused once they have.
oversight.pp_accessCut: Access is cut on their next request. Enrollments are kept.
oversight.pp_canSignInAgain: The account can sign in again immediately.
oversight.pp_removeFromRosterQ: Remove this student from the roster?
oversight.pp_studentUpdated: Student updated — recorded in the audit log
oversight.ac_frozenTitle: The pricing snapshot is frozen and not editable
oversight.ac_frozenBody: A course's pricing method and revenue split were frozen when it was created, from the platform pricing configuration — settlement reads them, so changing one would re-rate a live course. They are shown here and edited nowhere. The hall cannot be swapped for the same reason: a different hall means a new class.
oversight.ac_hallPriceTitle: Hall price is not a revenue share
oversight.ac_hallPriceBody: The price here is what the center shows teachers when booking. The revenue split and the per-student rate are platform pricing configuration and live on their own screen.
oversight.ac_enrolNote1: Enrolling creates the roster link only — it does
oversight.ac_enrolNote3: create a subscription, so it does not hand out paid coverage. Unenrolling refunds nothing.
oversight.ac_newTeacher: New teacher (must be affiliated with this center)
oversight.ac_studentNotified: The student is notified with your reason.
oversight.ac_needStudentCourse: Pick a student and a course
oversight.ac_needCourseFields: Title, subject, teacher, days and dates are required
oversight.ac_courseCreated: Course created — schedule generated, recorded in the audit log
oversight.ac_courseUpdated: Course updated — recorded in the audit log
oversight.ac_studentEnrolled: Student enrolled — recorded in the audit log
oversight.ac_teacherReassigned: Teacher reassigned — recorded in the audit log
oversight.pp_teacherLosesAccess: They lose access on their next request. Courses, schedules and all financial history are untouched.
oversight.pp_affiliationEnds: Their affiliation ends. Refused while they have active courses here — cancel or reassign those first.
oversight.collabCreateNote: For a teacher who ALREADY has an account — the invite button next to this one is shell-account onboarding and refuses one. This lands as a pending request: the teacher is notified, and only their acceptance creates the affiliation, course, schedule and pricing snapshot. No rate is entered here — every rate is superadmin config, and on a hall offering both pricing methods the teacher picks when accepting.

deletionQueue.title: Account deletion requests
deletionQueue.subtitle: Personal-data deletion requests under Egypt's Law 151/2020.
deletionQueue.ledgerNotice: Approving erases personal details only (name, email, phone, guardian contact). Financial records — payments, receipts, settlements — remain exactly as they are, without a name, because the law requires us to keep them and because they cannot be edited in the first place.
deletionQueue.subject: Account holder
deletionQueue.approveConfirmBody: The account is disabled immediately and its personal details are permanently erased. Erasure cannot be undone.
deletionQueue.approvedOk: Request executed and personal details erased
deletionQueue.actionFail: The action could not be completed
deletionQueue.notAnonymized: Account disabled but personal details not yet erased
